records.summary: Checkout p95 latency increased to 2400 ms against a 250 ms SLO; error rate is 12%.
Payments metrics remain within SLO during the checkout incident.
Connection pool exhausted errors began after checkout version 2.8 was deployed.
Checkout version 2.8 was deployed at 08:00 UTC; the previous stable version was 2.7.
Deployment 2.8 reduced the database connection pool from 100 to 5.
For release-correlated pool exhaustion, ask the on-call owner to review rollback to the stable version. Automation must not perform it.

data.action: Review rollback to version 2.7 using the incident change process.

records.summary: Checkout requests are slow and contain downstream payment timeouts.
Checkout calls payments synchronously; investigate payments when checkout reports gateway timeouts.
Payments gateway latency is 1600 ms and retries increased sharply.
Gateway retry storm and upstream gateway timeout errors occur in payments.
Payments has no deployment near the incident; its stable release is unchanged.
Coordinate gateway-provider investigation and have the payments owner review retry/backoff settings; do not roll back merely because checkout is slow.

data.action: Escalate to the payments owner and gateway provider.

records.summary: Inventory telemetry has a collection gap; available samples do not establish an error trend or cause.
The latest inventory release predates the alert and no deployment correlation is established.
When telemetry is incomplete, escalate to on-call to restore collection and obtain current logs before attributing a cause.

data.action: Collect reliable telemetry and request human investigation.
